oid.description: An oid or prefix of 4 or more hex characters, or an array of them for several objects. With no path or parent, the last is the path.

query.description: Act on every object this query lists, across all tasks even inside a project.

filter.description: Act on every object this saved filter lists.

preview.description: Answer the changes and write nothing.

expect.description: Refuse, changing nothing, unless the set holds exactly this many objects.

path.description: A path such as work/clients/, starting from the project the command runs in.

global.description: Read path from the root, not from the project the command runs in.

project.description: Start path from the project at this path, such as pns/hooks/, from any folder. Not with global.

parent.description: Put it in the object with this oid or prefix.

meta.description: The request's details, as --meta KEY=VALUE passes them: harness, session, model, effort, version or any other key.
